notes.title: Fixes + Art Contest!
notes.content:
Hey guys! Just going to start off by saying THANK YOU ALL SO MUCH!
Our team made Alice in Stardom in just around a month for the NaNoRenO visual novel jam and we've been floored by the amount of love and support for the project. So, thank you all so much for checking it out!

Fixes

Second, we've implemented a few much-needed fixes and plan to have a few more out soon. A few of the fixes we've made include a few proofreading mistakes and the "flickering" Alice's sprite does when it's outfit change time.

Art Contest

Third... we're having an art contest for Alice in Stardom! You can win multiple prizes for drawing any of the AiS characters! For more info, check out either of these two pages:

 Blog Entry
 deviantART Journal


Feel free to submit your entry in our Discord server or on Twitter! 

Thank you guys!
